subScenes.name: 求助报失
subScenes.description: 旅行者向警察说明护照丢失并请求帮助。

qaPairs.triggerText: I think I left my wallet in the restaurant. Can you help me check?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我觉得我把钱包落在餐厅了，能帮我查一下吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客在餐厅发现钱包丢失，请求协助寻找

followUps.text: Of course, I’ll check the dining area and ask the cleaning staff right away.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，我马上去用餐区检查，并问一下清洁人员。

followUps.text: I’m sorry, but we don’t have a lost and found system. You might want to contact the front desk or security.
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，我们没有失物招领系统，您可以联系前台或安保人员。

followUps.text: Was it a black leather wallet? We found one just now — I’ll bring it to you.
followUps.text_cn: 是黑色皮质钱包吗？我们刚刚捡到一个，我马上拿给您。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于顾客在餐厅遗失贵重物品时主动求助的场景，回应需体现服务态度与处理效率差异

qaPairs.triggerText: Have you seen a blue phone case with a cracked screen? I think I dropped it near the counter.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有没有看到一个蓝色手机壳、屏幕碎了的手机？我觉得我掉在柜台附近了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客描述具体物品特征，请求帮助寻找遗失手机

followUps.text: Yes, a staff member just brought it in — here it is, please check the screen.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，有员工刚送来一个，给您，请检查一下屏幕。

followUps.text: We haven’t found it yet, but we’ll keep an eye out and call you if someone turns it in.
followUps.text_cn: 我们还没找到，但如果有人上交，我们会立刻打电话通知您。

followUps.text: I’m afraid we can’t search for personal items unless you file a report with management.
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，除非您向管理层提交正式报告，否则我们无法为您搜寻个人物品。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客需提供具体特征，回应体现服务流程差异：立即归还、承诺通知、流程受限

qaPairs.triggerText: I lost my credit card here. What should I do?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我在这里丢了信用卡，我该怎么办？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客意识到信用卡丢失，寻求紧急处理建议

followUps.text: First, call your bank to freeze the card — we can help you use our phone or give you a quiet corner.
followUps.text_cn: 首先，请立即联系银行挂失卡——我们可以帮您用我们的电话，或提供一个安静角落。

followUps.text: We can’t assist with financial matters, but here’s the number for your bank’s emergency line.
followUps.text_cn: 我们无法处理金融事务，但这是您银行的紧急热线号码。

followUps.text: We’ve had a few reports of card theft nearby — I’ll call security and help you file a statement.
followUps.text_cn: 我们最近收到几起附近信用卡被盗的报告，我会叫安保人员并帮您做一份声明。

qaPairs.usageNote: 涉及金融安全的紧急求助，回应需体现服务边界、资源支持与风险应对差异

subScenes.name: 提供信息
subScenes.description: 回答警察关于个人信息和丢失细节的问题。

qaPairs.triggerText: What seems to be the problem?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医院急诊科，护士询问患者症状

followUps.text: I can't breathe properly — it started suddenly.
followUps.text_cn: 我呼吸困难，突然发生的。

followUps.text: I think I broke my arm — it's swollen and I can't move it.
followUps.text_cn: 我觉得我胳膊断了，肿得厉害，动不了。

followUps.text: I'm having chest pain and feel dizzy — should I call an ambulance?
followUps.text_cn: 我胸口疼，还头晕，需要叫救护车吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于医院急诊场景中，患者回应医护人员的初步问诊，表达不同类型的紧急症状。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you need help finding the nearest pharmacy?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 需要我帮您找最近的药房吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 便利店店员见顾客神色不适，主动提供帮助

followUps.text: Yes, please — I need allergy medicine right away.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，拜托了，我马上需要抗过敏药。

followUps.text: No, thanks — I have some at home, but I’m not sure if it’s still good.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我家里有，但不确定是否还有效。

followUps.text: Could you tell me if they’re open now? I don’t want to go if they’re closed.
followUps.text_cn: 您能告诉我现在开门吗？我不想跑空。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于非医疗场所（如便利店）中，顾客对工作人员的援助提议做出不同反应，体现紧迫性、犹豫或信息确认需求。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 银行柜员发现客户情绪激动，询问是否需要紧急协助

followUps.text: Yes! My card was stolen and someone is draining my account now!
followUps.text_cn: 是的！我的卡被盗了，有人正在盗刷我的账户！

followUps.text: Not really — I just need to withdraw a large amount for an urgent trip.
followUps.text_cn: 不算紧急，我只是想取一大笔钱去赶紧急行程。

followUps.text: I’m not sure — my account shows a negative balance, but I just deposited money.
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定——账户显示透支，但我刚存了钱。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于银行服务场景中，客户对工作人员关于紧急程度的判断做出三种典型回应，涵盖欺诈、资金需求和系统错误三种真实高频情境。

subScenes.name: 询问流程
subScenes.description: 咨询下一步如何办理补证或临时证件。

qaPairs.triggerText: I need help immediately — what’s the procedure for emergency care here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我需要立即帮助——这里紧急救治的流程是什么？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医院急诊室：患者突发不适，询问急救流程

followUps.text: We’ll get you to triage right away — a nurse will assess you in 2 minutes.
followUps.text_cn: 我们马上带您去分诊，护士两分钟内为您评估。

followUps.text: I’m sorry, but we need you to fill out this form first — it’s required by law.
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，您必须先填写这份表格，这是法律要求。

followUps.text: Please stay calm — we’ve already called the ER team. They’re on their way now.
followUps.text_cn: 请保持冷静，我们已经呼叫急诊团队，他们正在赶来的路上。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于医院急诊场景，用户表达紧急需求时，工作人员根据不同资源状况给出三种典型回应

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve been waiting for over 30 minutes — can you tell me the next steps?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我已经等了30多分钟了——能告诉我接下来该做什么吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 银行柜台：客户办理紧急业务，长时间等待后询问流程

followUps.text: We’re processing your request — it’s in queue for a manager review. It’ll take 10–15 more minutes.
followUps.text_cn: 您的请求正在处理中，需经理审核，还需10到15分钟。

followUps.text: I can help you right now — please follow me to the priority counter for urgent cases.
followUps.text_cn: 我现在就能帮您，请跟我到紧急业务专柜。

followUps.text: I’m sorry, but we can’t proceed without your ID card — please go back and get it.
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，没有身份证我们无法继续，请回去取一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于银行等服务场景，客户因等待过久而追问流程，工作人员根据权限、材料、流程状态给出不同回应

qaPairs.triggerText: I’m having a panic attack — where do I go for help in this restaurant?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我正在经历恐慌发作——在这家餐厅里我该去哪里求助？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 餐厅：顾客突发心理危机，寻求紧急帮助

followUps.text: We have a first-aid kit and a quiet room in the back — I’ll take you there right away.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有急救箱和后方安静休息室，我马上带您过去。

followUps.text: I’ll call 911 for you — do you have someone we can contact?
followUps.text_cn: 我马上帮您拨打911，您有可以联系的人吗？

followUps.text: I’m not trained for medical emergencies — please sit down and breathe slowly while I call for help.
followUps.text_cn: 我没有接受过医疗急救培训，请坐下缓慢呼吸，我马上为您呼叫帮助。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于非医疗场所（如餐厅）中的心理/生理紧急求助，工作人员根据能力范围给出三种真实、有层次的回应

subScenes.name: 获取指引
subScenes.description: 确认需前往的机构、所需材料及联系方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: I need help quickly — where is the nearest emergency exit?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我需要快速帮助——最近的紧急出口在哪里？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 餐厅突发紧急情况，顾客寻求紧急出口指引

followUps.text: Go straight down this hallway, turn left at the fire alarm, and you'll see the exit sign.
followUps.text_cn: 直走这条走廊，在消防报警器处左转，就能看到出口标志。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, the main exit is blocked — please follow me to the secondary exit behind the kitchen.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，主出口被堵住了，请跟我到厨房后面的备用出口。

followUps.text: Call 911 first, then head to the exit near the restrooms — I'll alert security right away.
followUps.text_cn: 先拨打911，然后前往洗手间附近的出口——我马上通知安保人员。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于突发紧急情况（火灾、恐慌等）下快速获取逃生指引的对话，语气需简洁、权威、带紧迫感

qaPairs.triggerText: I'm lost — can you tell me how to get to the emergency room?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我迷路了——你能告诉我怎么去急诊室吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 医院大厅，访客或患者家属急需找到急诊室

followUps.text: Take the elevator to the first floor, then follow the red signs — it's just past the pharmacy.
followUps.text_cn: 坐电梯到一楼，跟着红色指示牌走，就在药房旁边。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — let me call the ER desk for you right now.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我现在就帮你打电话给急诊台。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, but you need to go to the main hospital building — this is the outpatient wing.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，您需要去主楼——这里是门诊区。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于医院环境中非工作人员寻求急诊指引的高频场景，回应需体现专业性与同理心

qaPairs.triggerText: I think I'm having a heart attack — where's the nurse station?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我觉得我心脏病发作了——护士站在哪里？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 银行或商场内突发健康危机，顾客急需医疗援助

followUps.text: I'm calling 911 now — stay right here, I'll bring a first aid kit and an AED.
followUps.text_cn: 我马上拨打911——请原地别动，我去拿急救箱和自动体外除颤器。

followUps.text: The nurse station is on the second floor — but I'll get someone to help you right away.
followUps.text_cn: 护士站在二楼——但我马上叫人来帮你。

followUps.text: I'm not trained for medical emergencies — I'll get the manager to call for help.
followUps.text_cn: 我没有接受过医疗急救培训，我马上叫经理来求助。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于非医疗机构中突发健康危机的求助场景，回应需体现快速响应与责任意识，避免虚假承诺

subScenes.name: 致谢离场
subScenes.description: 感谢警察协助并礼貌结束对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thank you so much for your help!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 餐厅服务结束，顾客致谢，服务员回应后顾客离场时的自然回应

followUps.text: You're welcome! Have a great day!
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！祝您今天愉快！

followUps.text: I really appreciate it — this saved me!
followUps.text_cn: 我真的非常感激，这帮了我大忙！

followUps.text: Thanks again — I’ll be back next week!
followUps.text_cn: 再次感谢！我下周还会再来！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于服务场景结束时顾客对工作人员感谢后的自然回应，体现不同情感态度和社交意图

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there anything else I can help you with?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 还有什么我可以帮您的吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员在顾客致谢后，主动询问是否还需帮助，顾客决定离场

followUps.text: No, that’s all — you’ve been amazing!
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，就这样，您太棒了！

followUps.text: Actually, could you tell me where the restroom is?
followUps.text_cn: 其实，您能告诉我洗手间在哪吗？

followUps.text: No thanks, I’m in a hurry — thanks again!
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，我赶时间，再次感谢！

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在感谢后面对服务人员的延伸询问，需自然过渡到离场，体现不同时间压力和需求变化

qaPairs.triggerText: We really appreciate your service today.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们今天非常感谢您的服务。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客（或团体）正式致谢，服务员回应后顾客准备离开

followUps.text: It was our pleasure — please come back soon!
followUps.text_cn: 这是我们的荣幸，欢迎下次再来！

followUps.text: We’ll definitely recommend you to our friends!
followUps.text_cn: 我们一定会向朋友推荐你们！

followUps.text: Thanks — we’re so grateful, especially after everything today.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，我们真的非常感激，尤其是在今天这一切之后。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于顾客以团体或正式口吻致谢时，服务员回应后顾客的三种典型离场回应，涵盖情感、社交与情境深度
